I hacked around on the site when they first introduced it, I could share the code I used to bypass the map skipping around if people are interested.

Seeing as I'm getting upvotes, apparently people are interested in this, so here's the code. You'll need Greasemonkey if you're on Firefox or Tampermonkey for Chrome-based browsers in order to run this script.

// ==UserScript==
// @name stopXYVerseMapMoving
// @namespace xyverse.com
// @description Stop the map from moving around on new messages
// @include http://xyverse.com/
// @version 1
// @grant none
// ==/UserScript==

{ // Scope variables so they don't appear in the window
 // Modifiable script parameters
 const ZOOM = 1, // Map zoom. [Default 2]
 CENTER = { x: 0, y: 0 }; // Map center [Default { x: ?, y: ? }]

 $(window).ready(() => { // Runs once the window is fully loaded
 let interval = setInterval(() => { // Runs every 50 milliseconds until setup is complete
 let map = window.map;
 if (map != null) { // If the map has been initialized
 clearInterval(interval); // Stop the interval
 map.panTo = () => {}; // Make `map.panTo` do nothing
 map.setZoom(ZOOM); // Set the map's zoom level
 map.setCenter(new google.maps.LatLng(CENTER.x, CENTER.y)); // Center the map on the user's specified coordinates
 }
 },50);
 });
}
